user.title: Connect to Tenda MW6
user.description: Connect directly to the local Tenda MW6 TCP/9000 service. No Tenda cloud is used.

data_description.host: IP address of the master node (the one exposing port 9000, e.g. 192.168.0.1).
data_description.serial: Serial number of any mesh node, printed under the unit and encoded in its QR code (e.g. E00000000000000000). No packet capture is required.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the router or read the client list.
error.invalid_auth: The router rejected the serial number.
error.invalid_serial: The serial number must be alphanumeric (6 to 32 characters).

abort.already_configured: This Tenda MW6 host is already configured.

init.title: Device map
init.description: The integration listed every device currently known to the router. Each line contains its IP, MAC and name. Edit the text after =. Leave it empty to display the IP.

data_description.device_aliases: Keep the IP and MAC. An empty name after = forces the IP to be displayed. Removing the entire line restores the name reported by the router.

error.invalid_aliases: Each line must use the IP | MAC = name format. The name may be empty.
